Official NSC · Nov 2021 · Mathematics Paper 1 · Question 4.1

The graph of f(x) = x² is shifted 2 units to the right. Which equation represents the new graph?
questions.explanation: Horizontal shift right by 2 units replaces x with (x − 2) in the function rule.
